serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Oh no…{{wi}} Not him again…
Bot: Good-day, sir.
Landlord: Oh! Welcome my dear little tenants! 
You: Huh? You are too nice, did something happen?
Landlord: Well, I will ignore that rude remark today, I’m in a really good mood, you see.
I don’t really want to ask him that, but he looks like he really wants to be asked…
You: Oh my~ Why is that?
Landlord: You see, my daughter is coming, hehe. She’s usually busy with her studies, but she found some time for her old man.
You: Have fun I guess.
Landlord: Oh, I will! I prepared many things for this occasion. I chose the movie, baked her favorite cupcakes, we are gonna have a blast, hehe.
This old fart, does he really think he’s impressing someone with his stupid college student daughter? He’s so proud of her that it makes me sick!
Bot: You must love your daughter very much.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Landlord: Of course I do! Are you dumb?
